summary: The live browser check passes with all four built-ins absent and a changed game state. Temporary mutants failed on a retained built-in, blank 200 page, wrong game, equal state digest, post-move exception, and calls to each missing built-in. No false PASS was found.
evidence: Audited HEAD and role_base_sha are 29ad3aa3783be9f39411f14213e626280f278ab0; phase_base_sha is 31af75444583c9236f342c908128c91da9f4f7e3.
The exact Phase 3 diff includes scripts/old-browser-check.mjs and record files; no src/ or test file changed for this phase.

The Green command returned started=true, moves=6, state_changed=true, all four absent_in_page values undefined, and errors=[]. A final rerun refreshed out/old-browser/check.json, which then held the same successful state.
A temporary copy that left structuredClone defined failed at assertDeleted with started=false, moves=0, and a recorded presence error.
A temporary stateDigest mutant returning equal JSON objects failed after the real game started and counted six inputs, with 'game state did not change after the move'.
A page-step mutant invoked each deleted API inside try/catch and sent each TypeError to console.error. The result recorded four TypeError messages, one for every deleted name, and exited nonzero.
A temporary post-move TypeError appeared in pageerror and made the run exit nonzero.
A temporary server returned a blank wrong page with HTTP 200. The script failed waiting for __apk3dReady with started=false and moves=0.

A temporary wrong-game selector failed waiting for the game card with started=false and moves=0. The normal script uses the exact GAME id selector and sets started only after the Phaser renderer and game object exist.
A fresh browser.newContext is created before the first page navigation; the init script is installed before goto, so the check uses no prior page or browser-context cache.
The project heavy-run gate passed 230 files, with 1 skipped; 3396 tests passed and 9 skipped.

The interim out/old-browser/check.json read during mutation testing showed a failed record different from the successful Green stdout. A final heavy-run Green rerun restored a successful record. Attribution for the interim overwrite is unknown.

After the final browser run, ss -ltn showed no listener on 5199, and ps showed no vite.js or chrome-headless-shell process. All owned scripts exited; no process needed killing. Process PIDs were not captured.
